title: Flat preservation and compatibility of the fixed residue tensor square
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface], [new-integral-residue-derived-pull-square], [new-integral-residue-tensor-presentation], [new-integral-residue-ordinary-monoidal] and [new-integral-residue-derived-monoidal]. For every scheme map f:X→Y the actual ordinary integral pullback preserves flat objects. Give its derived pullback the already constructed monoidal structure induced by that property and the constructed ordinary monoidal structure. For every integral derived complex M on Y, applying f* to the fixed right-tensor presentation on Y and then the oplax tensor comparison equals the fixed restriction/pullback comparison evaluated at reduction(M), followed by restriction of the inverse canonical scalar pull comparison, and then the fixed tensor presentation on X with B_X identified with f*B_Y. Both tensor presentations and the coefficient-pullback isomorphism are explicit constructions before the statement.

proof.text: Use the unchanged explicit coefficient-pullback and tensor-pull constructions, now re-exported from their acyclic presentation module.
Use flat preservation for actual ordinary integral inverse image and install its already constructed derived strong monoidal structure.

Package the two routes as natural transformations. On a homotopy representative whose image under ordinary inverse image is K-flat, postcompose both with the invertible common-model target comparison. The tensor-route and scalar-route computation formulas identify both composites with the same explicit model map, so cancellation proves the square on this representative.

Use residue_exists_kFlatMap_iso to choose such a representative for any derived object. Naturality of both transformations along its isomorphism gives the desired square after precomposition with an isomorphism; cancel that isomorphism.

    ∃ hFlat : (f)^*⟦integralCoeff ℓ E⟧.PreservesFlat,

            (residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).map

                M (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E Y) =
            (residueExchangeRestrictPullIso ℓ E f).hom.app
                ((residueExchangeReduction ℓ E Y).obj M) ≫

                (((residueExchangePullComparisons ℓ E).pull f).inv.app M) ≫

                ((residueExchangeUpperStar (integralCoeff ℓ E) f).obj M)
